name: Ras Resorts & Apart Hotels Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1985, Ras Resorts & Apart Hotels Ltd is in the business of Hotelling & Real Estate[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
RRAHL is primarily engaged in the business of owning, operating hotel and resort 
viz. Ras Resort by Treat,which is spread over 10 
acres of woodlands in Silvassa

pros: Stock is trading at 0.84 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 0.81% over last 3 years.
Company's cost of borrowing seems high
